manifest.name: Robot logistics workshop · 10/10/1/4/4/4 per minute

stockControl.mode: five deciders, independent chest item < cap; dynamic collector filters (an inserter holds at most five filters); the requester chest is capped by its own gated inserter

setupNotes: Factorio 2.1.25 Space Age, normal quality: AM2 and chemical plants, no modules, red belts, fast and bulk inserters, substations. WEST entrances north to south: sulfuric acid (pipe), plastic, copper, iron, steel (belts), lubricant (pipe). EAST: one passive provider chest with independent caps 50 construction robots, 50 logistic robots, 10 roboports, 50 storage chests, 50 passive provider chests, 50 requester chests (the requester chests come straight from their own machine beside it through a gated inserter). All circuits, cable, gears, pipes, engines, batteries, frames and steel chests are made inside. Preserve the red ring wires (per-tile hold readers), the green and red chest wires, the token wires, filters and caps. Supply electricity at any substation; the three are wired together.

Leave the shared chest unrestricted (no bar). Caps: 50 construction robots, 50 logistic robots, 10 roboports, 50 storage chests, 50 passive provider chests, 50 requester chests; the first five live in the five filter deciders, the requester chests in the permission decider of the inserter that fills the chest from its machine. The chest has 48 slots and the six products at their caps fill six.
The entrance panels show recipe totals at the targets. The production tokens run the products a little above target, so plan supply for the measured draw in the README, not for the panels.

Do not remove the red wires from ring tiles or the circuit conditions on the arms; the three arms on the west edge (plastic, iron, steel) are the ring entrances. The requester chest machine hands its product to the chest through the inserter at the chest’s west side; keep that inserter and its red and green wires.

versions.label: Requester chests
versions.summary: Adds the requester chest as a sixth product, four a minute, into the same output chest (one full stack of 50). Its machine stands beside the chest and a gated inserter fills it; the footprint grows by one column.

versions.label: Full-stack caps
versions.summary: The earlier string with five products: the chest holds one full stack of each (50 construction robots, 50 logistic robots, 10 roboports, 50 storage chests and 50 passive provider chests) before the collector stops taking that product.

versions.label: Twenty-robot caps
versions.summary: The oldest string: the chest stops at 20 construction robots, 20 logistic robots, 2 roboports, 10 storage chests and 10 passive provider chests. Same layout, machines and rates as the five-product string.

evidence.reason: Passing production and recovery evidence matches this exact import and prototype.

inserterCapacityResearch.technology: bulk-inserter unlock-equivalent baseline only; no later capacity upgrades
